segmentation.text: Where the signal is a green straight-through arrow alone:
may proceed straight through, but must not turn right or left.
lawfully within the intersection or an adjacent crosswalk at the time the signal is exhibited.

elements.justification: dev.traffic_signal, 'a signal head; state ∈ {..., green_arrow(dir), ...} with dir ∈ {left, right, straight, u_turn}; several states may be displayed at once': a green straight-through arrow alone is the head displaying green_arrow(straight) and no other state. Same atom as the index for the signal words of NRS_484B_307_2a and NRS_484B_307_4a_o1.

'Vehicular traffic': the admitted aggregates DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic ('pedestrians, ridden or herded animals, vehicles and other conveyances ... using any highway for purposes of travel') and DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle ('every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway'), both held, claimed as ru.aggregate and never expanded. 'facing the signal': the subject occupies (rel.occupies, 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region') a travel region c (st.travel_region, the kinds 'a device can govern') whose entrance end is intersection i (st.lane_enters, 'the intersection region a directed approach carrier runs into at its entrance end'; i of kind st.intersection) and which the head governs (dev.governs, 'the travel regions whose traffic the device controls'). Not a stand-in: dev.governs is not read as a position, st.lane_enters not as presence in the intersection. Same words, same atoms as the index (NRS_484B_307_2a).

The movement through intersection i (st.intersection) is the subject's passage from its entry (rel.occupies rising) to its exit. 'must not turn right or left': drv.motion.right_turn_through_region ('a turn to the right through region r, recognized as it leaves r') and drv.motion.left_turn_through_region ('a turn to the left through region r'); a reversal, drv.motion.u_turn_through_region ('turned so as to proceed in the opposite direction through region r'), is a turn to one hand carried past a right angle and is no movement 'straight through', so it is read with them (narrowing). 'may proceed straight through': a passage for which none of the three holds; the permission adds no duty. As the index maps the arrow movements of NRS_484B_307_4a_o1.

applicability: The subject, of the classes traffic and vehicle, has entered intersection i from a travel region c whose entrance end is i (st.lane_enters) and which a traffic signal head s governs (dev.governs): at the act's onset its footprint came to overlap i, having occupied c and not i at the observation before. At some observation of the passage, from that entry to the judged observation, s displayed a green straight-through arrow alone (green_arrow(straight) and no other state). The rule is judged at the passage's recognition: the observation at which the subject's footprint does not overlap i, having overlapped it at the previous observation.
obligation: At that recognition none of drv.motion.left_turn_through_region, drv.motion.right_turn_through_region and drv.motion.u_turn_through_region holds for the subject and i (step = p.heading_since_step_carla_scene_graph, turn_min = p.turn_heading_min, u_turn_min = p.u_turn_heading_min): the passage was made straight through.

narrowings.why: 'turn right or left' is read as a passage through the intersection recognized as a right turn, a left turn or a reversal of direction (a U-turn turns to one hand beyond a right angle and is not straight through). A heading change below p.turn_heading_min, such as a lane change made inside the intersection, is read as straight through.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A car occupies lane c, recorded as entering intersection i and governed by head s displaying green_arrow(straight) alone; it enters i, its heading changes by +88 degrees inside i, and it leaves i while s still displays the arrow.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: Same arrow; the car passes through i with a heading change of 2 degrees and leaves it.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: s displays circular_green alone from before the car's entry until after its exit; the car turns left through i.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but the source supplies no yaw rate for the car while it is inside i: which movement it made is unknown.

scenarios.name: occasion_s1
scenarios.narrative: s displays green_arrow(straight) alone at the car's entry into i and changes to circular_yellow alone while the car is turning left inside i; the car leaves i with a heading change of +90 degrees: the arrow was displayed for part of the passage only.

scenarios.name: occasion_s1_outside
scenarios.narrative: s displays green_arrow(straight) alone only while the car waits on c before its entry; from the entry to the exit s displays circular_green alone; the car turns left through i.

onset.words: the subject's entry into the intersection from its approach
onset.justification: The through-region acts begin, as their contracts state, 'at the observation at which a's footprint came to overlap r (rel.occupies), having not overlapped it at the previous observation: its entry into r'.

occasion.recognition: the observation at which the subject's footprint does not overlap the intersection, having overlapped it at the previous observation: its exit, where the through-region acts are recognized

under_way.words: the subject inside the intersection it entered, turning or holding its heading, from its entry to its exit
under_way.justification: An observation inside the act is one from the entry on at which the subject still overlaps i and its heading change since the entry, integrated from kin.yaw_rate ('rate of change of heading'), is being accumulated; before the entry the integration has not begun, so the motion, not the place alone, tells the act from what preceded it.

param_proposals.name: p.turn_heading_min
param_proposals.convention: the smallest heading change over the turn window at which a change of course counts as a turn rather than a lane change or a drift
param_proposals.source: proposed this iteration by LVMC_11_40_080_o1; repeated unchanged

param_proposals.name: p.u_turn_heading_min
param_proposals.convention: the smallest heading change magnitude over the turn window at which a turn counts as a reversal of direction
param_proposals.source: proposed this iteration by LVMC_11_40_080_o1; repeated unchanged
